name: Bark Scorpion
description: Smaller but venomous desert scorpions. Their sting causes muscle spasms and agony.

name: Bighorner
description: Mutated bighorn sheep. The rams charge with bone-crushing force.

name: Bloatfly
description: Swollen mutant flies that spit caustic larval projectiles.

name: Bloodbug
description: Oversized mosquitoes that drain blood through a barbed proboscis.

name: Bloodworm
description: Burrowing parasitic worms from Nuka-World. They erupt from the ground without warning.

name: Brahmin
description: Two-headed cattle. Docile unless threatened. The wasteland's main livestock.

name: Eyebot
description: Floating surveillance drones broadcasting pre-war propaganda and occasional lasers.

name: Feral Ghoul
description: Mindless husks driven by radiation and rage. They swarm.

name: Feral Mongrel
description: Wild irradiated dogs hunting in packs through the ruins.

name: Gecko
description: Six-foot lizards that slash with oversized claws.

name: Ghoul crazy
description: Ghoul crazies or feral ghouls are creatures .

name: Giant Ant
description: Ants the size of dogs, swarming from underground colonies beneath the Capital Wasteland.

name: Glowing Mole Rat
description: Irradiated mole rats that glow green and bite with radioactive teeth.

name: Glowing Radstag
description: Irradiated radstag that glows in the dark. Its antlers crackle with gamma energy.

name: House cat
description: House cats are creatures found in the Commonwealth, on the Island, and in Nuka-World in 2287.

name: Institute Scientist
description: Clean-suited researchers from below. Armed but not trained for wasteland combat.

name: Jackal Gang Member
description: Scavengers from the Jackal gang. Cowardly alone, dangerous in packs.

name: Liberator
description: Chinese communist propaganda bots. Tiny, numerous, and annoyingly persistent.

name: Mantis
description: Giant praying mantises with barbed forelegs.

name: Mindless ghoul
description: Mindless ghouls are creatures encountered in Necropolis .

name: Mirelurk Hatchling
description: Tiny but vicious. They swarm from egg clutches by the dozen.

name: Mole Rat
description: Burrowing pests with teeth that cut through boot leather.

name: Mr. Handy
description: General Atomics domestic servants. Armed with a buzz saw and flamethrower.

name: NCR Trooper
description: Republic soldiers stretched thin across the Mojave. Tired but determined.

name: Pig Rat
description: Mutated swine-rat hybrids with razor tusks.

name: Powder Ganger
description: NCRCF escapees armed with dynamite and grudges.

name: Protectron
description: Pre-war security bots. Slow, clumsy, but their lasers still work.

name: Rad Chicken
description: Somehow these survived the apocalypse too. They peck. It does nothing.

name: Rad rabbit
description: Rad rabbits are creatures that can be found on the Island in 2287.

name: Radgull
description: Radgulls are birds found in the Commonwealth and the Island in 2287.

name: Radroach
description: Dinner-plate-sized cockroaches. They survived the bombs just fine.

name: Radstag
description: Two-headed deer. Usually flee, but bucks charge when cornered.

name: Raider
description: Chem-addled scavengers armed with pipe weapons and bad intentions.

name: Rat
description: Oversized rodents scrounging through pre-war ruins.

name: Raven
description: Ravens are creatures found in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

name: Spore Plant
description: Carnivorous plants that spit toxic spores. Found in caves and Vault 22.

name: Super mutant guard
description: The super mutant guards are guards found in the Mariposa Military Base in 2161, tasked with...

name: Trog Fledgling
description: Recently turned trogs. Still recognizably human. That makes it worse.

name: Viper Gunslinger
description: Remnants of the Vipers gang. Fast draws and poison-tipped weapons.

name: Wolf
description: Irradiated wolves that hunt in coordinated packs across Appalachia.

name: Ant
description: Ants are creatures that appear in Nuka-World in 2287.

name: Bighorner Bull
description: Territorial bull that guards the herd. Its charge can flip a person over a fence.

name: Cave Cricket
description: Giant crickets infesting Nuka-World caverns. They leap and spit acid.

name: Centaur
description: FEV rejects — a writhing mass of fused limbs and tongues.

name: Children of Atom
description: Radiation-worshipping cultists. They embrace the Glow and want you to join them.

name: Coyote
description: Coyotes are animals commonly found in New California in 2161.

name: Cyberdog
description: Cyberdogs, also spelled as cyber dogs, are creatures found in the Mojave Wasteland and in Big...

name: Cyberhound
description: Cybernetic canines from Big MT. Fast and fitted with energy projectors.

name: Feral Ghoul Gangrenous
description: Rotting ferals whose attacks cause festering infections. Don't let them scratch you.

name: Feral Ghoul Roamer
description: Faster ferals that hunt in packs through subway tunnels.

name: Feral Ghoul Stalker
description: Quick and cunning ferals that circle before lunging for the throat.

name: Fiend
description: Chem-crazed raiders squatting in the Vegas ruins. Unpredictable and violent.

name: Fire Ant
description: Lesko's experiment gone wrong. These ants spit jets of flame from their mandibles.

name: Fire Gecko
description: Geckos that breathe streams of combustible fluid. Stay upwind.

name: Floater
description: Jellyfish-like FEV abominations that whip tendrils of acid.

name: Forged
description: Fire-worshipping raiders from Saugus Ironworks. They initiate recruits by burning them.

name: Gazelle
description: Gazelles are creatures found in the Nuka-World amusement park .

name: Glowing Bloodworm
description: Irradiated bloodworms. Larger, meaner, and they leave radioactive trails.

name: Glowing Cave Cricket
description: Irradiated cave crickets that swarm in the dark. Their acid glows green.

name: Golden Gecko
description: Irradiated geckos whose scales gleam with embedded isotopes.

name: Gulper
description: Salamander mutations from Far Harbor. They swallow prey whole.

name: Gunner
description: Well-organized mercenaries with military discipline and heavy weapons.

name: Lakelurk
description: Aquatic mirelurk cousins with a devastating sonic attack.

name: Legion Recruit
description: Caesar's foot soldiers. Disciplined, brutal, and trained to die fighting.

name: Lobotomite
description: Brain-damaged test subjects from Big MT. Violent and barely human.

name: Mirelurk
description: Mutant horseshoe crabs with impenetrable frontal shells. Aim for the face.

name: Mr. Gutsy
description: Military Mr. Handy variant. Plasma gun, bad attitude, and patriotic death threats.

name: Mutant Hound
description: Super mutant war dogs. Irradiated, fast, and attack on their master's command.

name: Nightstalker
description: Coyote-rattlesnake hybrids from Big MT. Silent until they strike.

name: Nuka-World Raider
description: Operators, Disciples, and Pack raiders vying for control of the park.

name: Radscorpion
description: Armor-plated arachnids the size of a Corvega. Their stingers inject neurotoxin.

name: Raider Psycho
description: Psycho-fueled berserkers who charge screaming into gunfire.

name: Raider Veteran
description: Survived long enough to get real armor and real weapons. Don't underestimate them.

name: Red Widow Bloodbug
description: Larger, meaner bloodbugs with a crimson carapace and insatiable thirst.

name: Robobrain
description: Robots with human brains in a dome. Smarter than most bots, and deeply unsettling.

name: Spore Carrier
description: Vault 22 survivors consumed by fungal parasites. They spread spores on death.

name: Stingwing
description: Scorpionfly mutations that swarm in irradiated wetlands.

name: Super Mutant
description: FEV-enhanced humans. Eight feet tall, green, and very angry.

name: Super Mutant Skirmisher
description: Ranged-focused mutants who take potshots from cover. Smarter than they look.

name: Swampfolk Scrapper
description: The weakest swampfolk, armed with crude melee weapons and raw aggression.

name: Swampfolk Tracker
description: Swampfolk hunters who know Point Lookout better than their own mutated faces.

name: Synth
description: Institute-made androids. Gen-1s are skeletal machines. Gen-2s almost pass for human.

name: Synth Strider
description: Fast-moving synth patrol units. They flank and coordinate with machine precision.

name: Talon Company Merc
description: Capital Wasteland mercenaries. They shoot first and loot second.

name: Trapper
description: Far Harbor's coastal raiders. They use harpoon guns and wear fisherman's gear.

name: Tribals
description: Point Lookout cultists devoted to dark rituals in the swamp.

name: Triggerman
description: Ghoul mobsters in pinstripe suits running rackets out of Goodneighbor.

name: Trog
description: Troglodyte mutations from The Pitt's radiation. Feral, fast, and hunt in packs.

name: Tunneler
description: Subterranean horrors from the Divide. Fast, vicious, and they hate the light.

name: Turret
description: Automated ceiling or tripod-mounted guns. They never miss twice.

name: Withered Feral Ghoul
description: Ancient ferals, desiccated but still deadly. They lunge with surprising speed.

name: Young Cazador
description: Juvenile cazadors. Smaller but just as venomous, and they travel in swarms.

name: Young Deathclaw
description: Juvenile deathclaw. Smaller and weaker, but still deadly to the unprepared.

name: Albino Radscorpion
description: Ghostly white radscorpion with extra-concentrated venom. Capital Wasteland's worst.

name: Alien
description: Small, grey, and packing energy weapons from beyond the stars.

name: Angler
description: Lure prey with a bioluminescent growth. Disguise as plants until they strike.

name: Assaultron
description: Agile combat robots that charge with bladed limbs and a devastating head laser.

name: BoS Knight
description: Brotherhood of Steel infantry in power armor. Well-trained and well-equipped.

name: Brahmiluff
description: Brahmiluffs are creatures found in the Nuka-World amusement park in 2287.

name: Cazador
description: Tarantula hawk wasps mutated to man-size. Their sting causes paralysis and screaming.

name: Charred Feral Ghoul
description: Blackened, radiation-scorched ferals. The toughest non-glowing variant.

name: Children of Atom Zealot
description: Devoted zealots wielding modified gamma guns. Their faith is literally radioactive.

name: Deathclaw
description: The apex predator of the wasteland. Twenty feet of muscle, horn, and nightmare.

name: Deathstalker Radscorpion
description: Burrowing variant that erupts from the earth. Its venom stops hearts in seconds.

name: Dog
description: Dogs are animals commonly found across New California in Fallout.

name: Enclave Soldier
description: America's shadow government made flesh. Advanced power armor, plasma weapons, and fanaticism.

name: Feral Ghoul Reaver
description: The worst ferals. They throw radioactive gore and shrug off bullets.

name: Forged Leader
description: Slag, the Forged boss, and his lieutenants. They dole out punishment by fire.

name: Ghost Harvester
description: Ghost people that wield bear trap fists. They collect things. Including you.

name: Ghost People
description: Sierra Madre hazmat suit horrors. Dismember them or they get back up.

name: Ghost Seeker
description: Ranged ghost people that hurl gas bombs and cosmic knife spears from the red fog.

name: Giant Ant Queen
description: Bloated monarch of the colony. Spawns soldiers endlessly until destroyed.

name: Giant Radscorpion
description: The emperor of the desert. Its carapace deflects small arms fire.

name: Giant mantis
description: Giant mantises (Mantis religiosa)Vault 22 terminal entries; Terminal, Species 2 are mutated...

name: Giant rat
description: Giant rats are creatures living in the Mojave Wasteland in 2281.

name: Glowing Bloatfly
description: A legendary irradiated bloatfly whose projectiles hit like plasma bolts. Don't laugh.

name: Glowing Gulper
description: Irradiated gulper whose bile is laced with gamma radiation.

name: Glowing Mutant Hound
description: Irradiated mutant hound that emits lethal radiation. Glows like a green lantern.

name: Glowing One
description: Ghouls saturated with gamma radiation. They heal nearby ferals with radioactive pulses.

name: Glowing Yao Guai
description: An irradiated yao guai that emits deadly radiation with every swipe.

name: Gorilla
description: The gorilla is a synthetic creature found contained inside the terrariums of Institute...

name: Gunner Commander
description: Gunner leadership. Power armor, planning, and a fat paycheck for your head.

name: Hermit Crab
description: Giant crabs using wrecked trucks as shells. That dumpster might be alive.

name: Honey Beast
description: Mutated bears covered in living beehives. The bees swarm when it attacks.

name: Legendary Nightstalker
description: An ancient alpha nightstalker, scarred and cunning. Its venom is concentrated death.

name: Legion Veteran
description: Hardened legionaries who have survived dozens of campaigns. They do not retreat.

name: Marked Man
description: Ghoulified soldiers still fighting the war in the Divide. Armed and relentless.

name: Marked men
description: The marked men are a unique variant of ghoul encountered exclusively within the region known...

name: Mega Sloth
description: Enormous irradiated sloths with fungal growths. Slow but devastating when provoked.

name: Mirelurk Deep King
description: Ancient mirelurk king from the deep. Its sonic blast can shatter concrete.

name: Mirelurk Hunter
description: Faster, leaner mirelurks that spit corrosive bile at range.

name: Mirelurk King
description: Amphibious humanoid with a devastating sonic attack that disorients and damages.

name: NCR Ranger
description: The best the Republic has. Black armor, brush guns, and cold efficiency.

name: Nightkin
description: Stealth Boy-addicted mutants. Schizophrenic, invisible, and terrifyingly fast.

name: Nuka-World Raider Boss
description: Gang bosses ruling Nuka-World's factions. Gage says they're reasonable. They're not.

name: Putrid Glowing One
description: Bloated, oozing glowing ones whose radiation bursts can resurrect nearby corpses.

name: Rad-rat
description: Rad-rats are creatures found in the Nuka-World amusement park in 2287.

name: Raider Boss
description: The meanest dog in the pack. Better armed and twice as paranoid.

name: Robot Scorpion
description: Big MT creation. Mechanical scorpions with energy weapon stingers.

name: Securitron
description: Mr. House's robot army. Polite screen-face, gatling laser, and missile pods.

name: Securitron Mk II
description: Upgraded securitrons with full weapon suites unlocked. Grenade launchers and missiles online.

name: Snallygaster
description: Multi-tentacled acid-spitting horror. Shrieks before it charges.

name: Super Mutant Brute
description: Bigger, meaner mutants that swing sledgehammers like baseball bats.

name: Super Mutant Butcher
description: They earned the name. The meat bags hanging from their camp aren't brahmin.

name: Super Mutant Enforcer
description: Pack enforcers who keep lesser mutants in line through sheer brutality.

name: Super Mutant Suicider
description: Carries a live mini nuke and sprints at you beeping. Shoot the bomb. SHOOT THE BOMB.

name: Swampfolk Bruiser
description: Massive inbred swampfolk that absorb punishment like sponges. Hit like trucks.

name: Triggerman Boss
description: Top of the Triggerman food chain. Armored, armed, and ruthlessly organized.

name: Trog Brute
description: Larger trogs that have survived long enough to grow massive and aggressive.

name: Wanamingo
description: Alien-looking predators nesting in abandoned mines. Ferocious and territorial.

name: Wendigo
description: Emaciated monstrosities with elongated limbs. Fast, savage, and always hungry.

name: Yao Guai
description: Mutated black bears. Fast, aggressive, and utterly fearless.

name: Abomination
description: Abominations are creatures found on board Mothership Zeta in 2277.

name: Albino Deathclaw
description: Ghostly white and nearly impervious. Bullets seem to make it angrier.

name: Alien Captain
description: Commanding officer aboard Zeta. Tougher, meaner, and armed with alien tech.

name: Alpha Deathclaw
description: Pack leader. Scarred, massive, and cunning enough to flank.

name: Assaultron Dominator
description: Top-tier assaultron with an overcharged head laser that melts power armor.

name: Bloated Glowing One
description: Enormously swollen glowing one. Its radiation burst can kill from twenty feet away.

name: BoS Paladin
description: Elite Brotherhood warriors. Full power armor, heavy weapons, and sworn duty.

name: Chameleon Deathclaw
description: Turns invisible. You hear the footsteps, then the screaming starts.

name: Deathclaw Matriarch
description: Mother of the nest. Fights with desperate ferocity to protect her clutch.

name: Enclave Officer
description: Enclave command staff in top-tier power armor. They fight for a dead America.

name: Epic Behemoth
description: An ancient behemoth, scarred by centuries of battle. Basically a walking building.

name: Fog Crawler
description: Enormous shrimp-like horrors from the Island fog. Their screech freezes blood.

name: Gatorclaw
description: Deathclaw-alligator hybrids from Nuka-World's Safari Adventure. Jackson's legacy.

name: Glowing Angler
description: Irradiated angler emitting a sickly green glow from beneath the fog.

name: Glowing Deathclaw
description: Irradiated deathclaw wreathed in green light. Its claws leave radioactive wounds.

name: Glowing Fog Crawler
description: Irradiated fog crawler pulsing with green energy. Tougher than most deathclaws.

name: Glowing Gatorclaw
description: Irradiated gatorclaw. Somehow they made the alligator-deathclaw worse.

name: Glowing Hermit Crab
description: A radioactive hermit crab the size of a bus. Its shell glows through the fog.

name: Glowing Mirelurk King
description: Irradiated mirelurk king whose sonic blasts carry a lethal dose of radiation.

name: Gojira
description: Gojira is an unused creature found in the Fallout: New Vegas game files.

name: Grafton Monster
description: Headless abomination that hurls acidic projectiles. A West Virginia legend made real.

name: Legendary Cazador
description: A monstrous queen cazador. One sting delivers enough venom to kill a brahmin.

name: Legendary Sentry Bot
description: Annihilator-class sentry bot. Dual gatling lasers and a self-destruct you don't want to be near.

name: Legion Centurion
description: Veteran commanders in salvaged power armor fragments. The Legion's finest.

name: Mirelurk Queen
description: Towering matriarch that spawns hatchlings and sprays acid. A walking catastrophe.

name: Mongrel
description: Mongrels are creatures that can be found in the Commonwealth in 2287.

name: Mythic Deathclaw
description: The pinnacle of deathclaw evolution. Settlers speak its name in whispers.

name: NCR Ranger Veteran
description: Black-armored desert rangers. One shot, one kill. The Mojave's deadliest humans.

name: Night stalker
description: Night stalkers (sometimes spelled "nightstalkers") are creatures living in the Mojave...

name: Radscorpion Queen
description: Massive broodmother that burrows and ambushes. Her carapace is nearly impenetrable.

name: Savage Deathclaw
description: Battle-scarred and territorial. It has killed everything that challenged it.

name: Scorchbeast
description: Giant irradiated bats that carpet-bomb with sonic attacks. Appalachia's apex threat.

name: Sentry Bot
description: Walking tanks with dual miniguns and missile launchers. Find cover immediately.

name: Skulking Fog Crawler
description: The apex fog crawler. Enormous, aggressive, and nearly indestructible.

name: Stripe
description: Stripe is a miniature deathclaw found in the year 2281 at the Big MT in the Fallout: New Vegas...

name: Super Mutant Behemoth
description: Three stories tall. Carries a fire hydrant on a chain as a weapon. Run.

name: Super Mutant Master
description: The smartest and deadliest mutants. They coordinate attacks and use heavy weapons.

name: Super Mutant Overlord
description: Massive mutants wielding tri-beam laser rifles and super sledges. Bullet sponges.

name: Super Mutant Primus
description: Ancient mutants approaching behemoth size. Their green skin has darkened to near-black.

name: Super Mutant Warlord
description: The ultimate super mutant variant. Towering, heavily armed, and nearly unkillable.

name: Swampfolk
description: Swampfolk are a mutated type of human found in Point Lookout in 2277.

name: Synth Courser
description: Elite Institute hunters. Teleport in, eliminate targets, teleport out. Relentless.

name: Tunneler Queen
description: Matriarch of the tunneler hive. Larger, tougher, and commands swarms of drones.

name: Venomous Angler
description: Ancient angler whose lure burns with toxic fire. One of Far Harbor's deadliest.
